name: ModelVariant180_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant180_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (expanding, fading rings at this slot, a screen flash, and then pairs of rays that grow upwards around the other slot); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request, copies both slot positions, builds the ring and ray points and packs two texture images, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 before the rays start, 4 while they grow, then 1 once and 2; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; only the USA and Japanese discs build this header. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
